Transformer Protection 
 Scheme
 For 1,2 AT01,
 BT01 of unit 1,2 150 MW

This 
 document outlines the testing procedures P1, which must performed 
 every six months as 
 indicated by M6 in the titled block

This patent 
concerns the test of protection relays of the transformer manufactured by AEG. 
The Transformer rated active power 150 MW, rated apparent power 187 MVA, power 
factor 0.8, and voltages 10.5 KV

The first draft is initiated by eng. Fathy Abd El 
Salam Hassan tested by eng. Mahamed Tohamy, accepted by electrical general 
manger eng. Said Farag, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. 
Adel Abd ELQader El-nagar, and approved by eng. Moukhtar Abd Ellateef Mady; head 
sectorof Ataka PS.

This document accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilil: EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, and quality control general 
director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.

A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes ...etc.

Ensure the disconnection of the 
 exciter, generator, main transformer and home transformer .

Set up a work permission including 
 maintenance members, safety class, etc.
Be aware of parts in service.
Check device
Digital Timer
Review the manual.
Prepare the previous results of the relay testing.
Check the wires of the relay beforehand.

Be sure that the unit and the transformer are disconnected and the d.c. source 
 is available.
Check the existence of the d.c. sources in panels.
Disconnect the trip leads of the relay and connect the timer to them.
Check all the leads used in tests.
Connect the test plug

Connect the timer to a power source 
 and its terminals to the trip terminals of the relay under test.

The test of almost all generator 
 protection devices is achieved by isolating either CT circuits or PT circuits 
 or both. This is done by using a special selector switch.
Place selector switch on the test mode.
insert the test plug in special board.
Insert timer the plug in special socket.
Repeat the steps for the other three of phases.
Record the results.
The steps from 1 to5 are apply for all protection relays.

Introduction

Preparation

The test of almost all generator

Protection Devices
Manufacturer of all devices: AEG

Test 
Steps
Place selector switch on the test mode.
insert the test plug in special board.
Insert timer the plug in special socket.
Repeat the steps for the other three of phases.
Record the results.
The steps from 1 to5 are apply for all protection relays.
